artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan generalizing bimodal's search-solver re-assertion into the shared ConstraintGenerator, with live non-mocked regression coverage for logos/exclusion/imposition.

memory_candidates.content: In the ModelChecker Z3 stack, ModelDefaults._setup_solver (models/structure.py) adds every constraint via assert_tracked, which Z3SolverAdapter implements as z3.Solver.assert_and_track(c, Bool(label)). Z3 records that as Implies(label, c), so solver.assertions() returns TRACKED IMPLICATIONS, not the raw constraints. Copying those assertions into a fresh z3.Solver() yields a vacuously satisfiable set -- the copy checks sat with every tracking Boolean set False, even when the original checked unsat. Consequence: any mechanism that reconstructs a solver by copying assertions() off a tracked solver is silently unconstrained, and a regression test asserting only len(assertions()) > 0 will pass against a broken engine. Re-assert the real constraint lists (frame/model/premise/conclusion off ModelConstraints) instead of copying assertions, and make the acceptance criterion model-level (the produced model satisfies each constraint), not count-level.
